theorems.name: Submission.rsod_mem_regularSet_of_density_one
theorems.statement: AllardRegularityTheorem → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, V.HasDensity x₀ 1 → x₀ ∈ V.regularSet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
